The '''Aorala Sensor 100''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] device manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. The sense-constro technology pioneered in the Aorala was intregal to the [[MoveSense 34 Motion Trip]].
